correctness.rationale: The full Weierstrass normal form is in Ciliberto et al. Sec 2.4. A complete argument shows image and inverse via the unique linear dependence of three squarefree pair quadratics. Six simple roots and nonzero c4 imply exactly I2 Kodaira fibers. The root determinant product descends to a degree-15 invariant; a repeated-root nonvanishing witness certifies trivial permutation character and a simple-zero witness certifies reducedness. Degree-two map of P1 proves involution criterion; Riemann--Hurwitz gives biellipticity. Generic uniqueness follows from a six-root example with precisely C2 stabilizer plus dimension/open-stabilizer arguments; the unique matching and unique relation reconstruct the Weierstrass surface up to permitted isomorphism. Exact sympy test runs 720 relabelings and explicit discriminant. Bounds: characteristic zero and squarefree only. No finite sample is treated as proof of infinitude.
